Name: Wilford Loves Tulips
Author: aneirine
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A small mod that adds Tulip as Custom NPC Wilford's favourite gift if you want to befriend him early in the game.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Adds unique dialogue for this gift.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]- SMAPI[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Content Patcher[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Wilford - New Custom NPC[/color]

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7313]Wilford - New Custom NPC[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/86035733]FloranceBless[/url] - original author of the character[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18011]Wilford Anime Portrait by Bunzbunz[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/185039619]bunzbunzMODS[/url] - portraits used in the screenshots
- [url=https://blog.naver.com/delloti/222796955126]Delloti's Flower Retexture[/url] - retexture of the flower used in the screenshot


[/color]
